cards.mood: The piece opens with a contemplative and slightly melancholic atmosphere, establishing a sense of longing.
cards.palette: Distorted electric guitars serve as the core harmonic and melodic drivers, entering with clean arpeggios in the intro and switching to heavy, palm-muted power chords in the verses.
